title: [SOLVED] hyprland > 0.55.4-1 crashes, missing libhyprutils.so.12
body: When upgrading hyprland (currently 0.55.4-1) it crashes with this error: error while loading shared libraries: libhyprutils.so.12: cannot open shared object file: No such file or directory Reinstallation does not solve the issue. Do you have any tips on how to tackle this problem? Last edited by GscheadaHamme (2026-11-02 23:00:49)
